tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx' && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
g=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json'))
cl=g['checklist']
prog={"skill":"run-dev-graph-system-spec","loop":1,"original_goal_hash":g['original_goal_hash'],
"checklist":[
 {"item":cl[0],"status":"achieved","evidence":"c24-receipt.json exit0; R0-context verifier PASS (eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R0-context/verifier-result.json)"},
 {"item":cl[1],"status":"achieved","evidence":"version 0.1.25 in >=0.1.22 <1.0.0; 4 entry points present; R1-preflight verifier PASS"},
 {"item":cl[2],"status":"not_achieved","evidence":"R2 pending: elicit/doc-fetch/compile/evaluator not yet delegated"},
 {"item":cl[3],"status":"not_achieved","evidence":"coverage/citation exit0 in loop1; evaluator gate pending"},
 {"item":cl[4],"status":"not_achieved","evidence":"R3 C02 import pending"},
 {"item":cl[5],"status":"not_achieved","evidence":"R3 duplicate-logic audit pending"}],
"feedback_criteria":[
 {"id":"IN1","status":"PASS","loops":[{"loop":1,"status":"PASS","evidence":"coverage exit0, source-citation exit0, validate-graph-schema --strict-artifact-readiness exit0"}]},
 {"id":"OUT1","status":"external_pending","evidence":"judged by post-run live trial"}],
"blockers":[]}
json.dump(prog,open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-progress.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)
row={"original_goal":g['original_goal'],"original_goal_hash":g['original_goal_hash'],
"current_goal_snapshot":"loop1: R0 context+R1 preflight PASS (independent verifiers), IN1 gates exit0, graph 0 nodes",
"delta_from_original":"R2 (harness canonical flow + evaluator) and R3 (C02 import) remain",
"merged_directive_for_next":"loop2: invoke system-spec-harness elicit --resume, decide doc-fetch, compile, build-evaluation-context then C05 evaluator; then R2 verifier",
"drift_signal":"none"}
open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl','a').write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
PY
DEV_GRAPH_ROOT='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx' && python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
PY
echo hashcheck=$?
tool_input.description: Record loop-1 progress and verify hashes
